messages:
alejandra: im opening a small docs PR: "private/VPC migration notes". piecing together MTU troubleshooting, a tiny PKCS#11 HSM example, sha256 checksum for air-gapped bundles, a compact installer vs runtime ports list, and a modern JS SDK proxy snippet. need 1-2 reviewers.

mike: include exact ports and label which are installer-only vs runtime. customers keep asking.

alejandra: yes. draft ports: installer: 443 (downloads), 22 (ssh optional), 2379 (etcd bootstrap), 30000-31000 (bootstrap temp). runtime: 6443 (k8s api), 10250 (kubelet), 50051 (rpc), 9000 (metrics). note about NAT/ephermeral ranges.

jin: current HSM link is dead in our docs. replacement: https://hsm-vendor.example.com/linux-pkcs11-guide. adding a minimal pkcs11 snippet and a short troubleshooting bullet list (ldd, selinux, perms).

emily: i'll validate the sha256 snippet on sealed-site-qa1 once PR is up. suggest adding a dos2unix note for Windows transfers.

alejandra: proposed checksum snippet:

```
# build host
sha256sum redwood-offline-bundle.tar.gz > redwood-offline-bundle.tar.gz.sha256
# sealed site target
dos2unix redwood-offline-bundle.tar.gz.sha256 || true
sha256sum -c redwood-offline-bundle.tar.gz.sha256
```

ops-tim: MTU note: on 1400 path we reproduced etcd restore stalls and flaky websocket handshakes. repro: restore a ~100MB snapshot across MTU=1400 and watch for repeated retransmits; kube-apiserver may need tuning for long-lived streams. i'll paste exact steps in PR comments.

emily: JS SDK proxy snippet (avoid rejectUnauthorized false):

```js
const fetch = require('node-fetch');
const HttpsProxyAgent = require('https-proxy-agent');
const agent = new HttpsProxyAgent('http://proxy.local:3128');

await fetch('https://redwood.internal/api/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  agent,
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_KEY}` },
  body: JSON.stringify({ prompt: 'hello' })
});
```

jin: add DOCKER_BUILDKIT env tip and no_proxy example to avoid build-time proxy escapes.

mike: i'll review later today, focusing on the port list and MTU repro phrasing. emily, ping when checksum test finishes.

docs-bot: CI started for branch docs/private-vpc-migration-notes (build #721) :construction_worker:
